Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value from activities joined to assays on assay_id, assays joined to target_dictionary on tid, activities joined to molecule_dictionary on molregno, molecule_dictionary inner joined to compound_structures on molregno. Filter to target chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1944', target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN', tax_id = 9606, standard_type = 'IC50', standard_relation = '=', and pchembl_value is not null. Keep every qualifying activity row without deduplication. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit to 1000 rows.
